Secure derives from the request the same way

the per-request statement budget, counted through the PHP bridge's /query, /batch and /exec and CodeIgniter's DBQuery event; v4 has neither seam, so these numbers do not transfer and this is not a port. The concern does not shrink with the bridge: on rqlite every query is an HTTP round trip (D1's reversal) and on D1 rows read are billed, so an N+1 page costs latency and money here more visibly than on PHP. Revision 50: owes statement counts per request on v4's Sql wrapper for the list, detail, search and session pages, then a budget declared at measured + margin - the runner's number, never v3's (D34 applied to a budget). Rides G7's performance sanity beside p95: p95 states the cost in milliseconds, a budget states it in queries
